description: GOV-13 brain knowledge source: captures brain agent/items (GET only, through integrations.vmc.BrainReadClient and the plx_hub_guard grammar) for the probe principal's granted namespaces into a fresh capture store, projects them as KnowledgeItem, and runs plx.find as the granted principal and as a principal the namespace authority names nowhere. Counts and booleans only; no item text is printed.
notes: Live-unverified until the live check records a result; module tests are injected-transport (integrations/tests/test_knowledge_source.py, which runs this command's arguments through check_expectations). agent/items is the one brain route used: unlike agent/search it bumps no access counter (05-VMC-BRAIN-TOOLS.md 4.1). The Portal Knowledge Service has no Workbench-reachable route and the reporting API allowlist (plx-customer-portal@790256c services/workbench-api/manifest/allowlist.json) serves no knowledge relation, so the brain is read directly, as the Portal's knowledge.graph namespace does. Granted namespaces are the probe's own; production grants come from a plx-knowledge-namespaces/v1 document. The capture is offset-paged and non-atomic; complete=false means the 5000-item cap was hit or the source moved during the read (total changed, or the first page re-read at the end differs), and then nothing is marked missing. json_min requires at least one kept item, projected object and granted-reader candidate, so the check cannot pass proving nothing. registry_names: relations names the brain relation (items) this run holds records of; the source registry credits it with the check's result.
